summary: Liquid AI's agent model: 24B total, 2.45B active per token, 131K context, always reasons before answering. Liquid trained it with RL inside OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Pi and OpenCode. On Liquid's chart it beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on agent and tool-use tests (LiveClaw 48.09 vs 38.19) but trails it on coding (SWE-Bench Verified 51.0 vs 66.2). About 14-15 GB at 4-bit.

practical_baseline.reason: Released 2026-10-13: one builder report and Liquid's own speed table so far, no measured run.
